layout_sources: https://github.com/abesto/ofxstatement-otp (README: the OTP netbank download is an XLSX; the CSV/XML exports belonged to the netbank retired in September 2021; the layout changed in June 2026 to a metadata preamble, a relocated header and a new column order) and https://pypi.org/project/ofxstatement-otp/ 0.2.0 src/ofxstatement_otp/otp.py (sheet "Tranzakciók"; preamble labels in column A with values in B, among them "Lekérdezés kezdete"/"Lekérdezés vége" as YYYY-MM-DD; header row found by "Számlaszám" + "Ellenoldali számlaszám"; 11 columns; transaction time "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" and booking date "YYYY-MM-DD" usually as text; signed amounts; currency column; one file can hold several accounts)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abesto/ofxstatement-otp/HEAD/manual_test/generate_sample.py (the full header words and preamble rows of a synthetic export modelled on a real one: Számlatörténet, Számlaszám, Lekérdezés időpontja/kezdete/vége, Szűrési feltétel; account numbers written without dashes)
Older headerless semicolon CSV (pre-2021): https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/hu/otp/default.json and bank2ynab [HU OTP]
notes: OTP Internetbank "Számlatörténet" download, Excel only (no CSV in the current netbank). Sheet "Tranzakciók": a preamble (title, account list, query time, period start and end, filter) in columns A:B, the header on row 9, then one row per line. Dates are text cells ("2026-10-02 14:31:07" and "2026-10-03"), not date serials; Összeg is a signed number in forints; Devizanem HUF. Oldest first. No balance. Expected dates are "Könyvelés dátuma" (booking); expected amounts are in fillér (HUF has two minor digits in ISO 4217). The synthetic sample this follows was built from a real export by the plugin author, but this layout is only a few months old.
